Profile

Aldar Properties PJSC is a real estate developer and asset manager headquartered in Abu Dhabi and listed on the Abu Dhabi Securities Exchange. The company organises its activities around two core businesses: Aldar Development, which plans and builds residential and mixed-use communities, and Aldar Investment, which holds and operates a portfolio of commercial, retail, hospitality and education assets.

Its development arm works from a land bank of roughly 65 million square metres and concentrates on several of the capital's best-known destinations, including Yas Island, Saadiyat Island, Al Raha and Reem Island. Alongside its own projects, the group manages government housing and infrastructure programmes on a fee basis through Aldar Projects, and runs separate platforms for new ventures and for mixed-use development in Egypt. Its circular headquarters tower on Al Raha Beach has become one of the more recognisable buildings on the Abu Dhabi skyline.

Key areas of activity

  • Master-planned residential communities
  • Commercial, retail and hospitality investment
  • Government housing and infrastructure delivery (Aldar Projects)
  • Education and community services
